record.question: Does this graph establish a complete lake camping itinerary?
record.reason: Camp/Bear remain bounded Crabtree approaches requiring an exit itinerary. Separate western routes now represent Lake Valley, Pine Valley and the eastward Gem continuation; their existence does not add those segments to the Camp/Bear routes. Shoreline circulation, individual campsites, current water and restroom availability remain unresolved. Historical maps are not current clearance.
